lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: There is a service floor under the lattice. It appears on no plan, it has never been allocated a maintenance window, and no part of the system has a record of anyone going down to it.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The stair leading down from it does not end where a stair should.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Four chairs up there. Three instruments and a man. And if he has held that seat since 2091, he has been holding it from somewhere — a seat is a place, and the place is under our feet.
